name: QR-DQN + Double + Non-crossing
tagline: QR-DQN with a Double-Q target and a soft penalty on quantile crossing across all actions.

key_hyperparams.name: cross_coef λ_c
key_hyperparams.role: weight on non-crossing penalty (sum over all actions)

key_hyperparams.name: Double-Q
key_hyperparams.value: online next-state argmax, target net evaluates

init_recovers: QR-DQN baseline at λ_c=0 (drops the non-crossing term).
diff_from_baseline: On top of the QR-DQN baseline, adds a quadratic ReLU penalty on adjacent-quantile inversions (across all actions, not just the chosen one) and switches the target-action selection to Double-Q (online net argmax) instead of target-net argmax.

name: IQN + TD-Weighted Latent Smoothing
tagline: Implicit Quantile Networks with cosine τ-embedding and an extra TD-weighted MSE between current and next-state encoder features.

key_hyperparams.name: weighting
key_hyperparams.role: high weight where TD is small (confident)

diff_from_baseline: Replaces QR-DQN's fixed quantile head with an IQN cosine-embedded head and adds a per-sample TD-confidence latent regulariser exp(−|δ|)·‖φ(s)−φ(s')‖² that smooths consecutive-state encoder features only when the value estimate is reliable.

name: IQN with Double Action Selection
tagline: Cosine-embedded Implicit Quantile Network with Double-IQN target (online net selects, target net evaluates the quantile).
formula: $$\phi_\tau = \mathrm{ReLU}\bigl(W_\phi\,[\cos(i\pi\tau)]_{i=1}^{n_{cos}}\bigr),\quad q_\tau(s,a) = W_o\bigl(\phi(s) \odot \phi_\tau\bigr)_a$$$$\mathcal{L} = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{j=1}^{N'} \rho_1^{\tau_i}\!\bigl(r + \gamma\,q^{\bar\theta}_{\tau'_j}\!\bigl(s', \arg\max_{a'} \bar Q^{\theta}(s', a'; K)\bigr) - q^{\theta}_{\tau_i}(s, a)\bigr)$$

key_hyperparams.name: K
key_hyperparams.role: τ samples used for Double action selection

init_recovers: Plain IQN when next_actions are taken from the target network.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to QR-DQN baseline, switches the head to an IQN cosine-embedded quantile network and adds Double-IQN target action selection (argmax via online net, evaluation via target-net quantiles); uses larger N=N'=64.

name: Adaptive Risk-Tempered QR-DQN
tagline: QR-DQN where target action is chosen by a TD-uncertainty-driven mix of mean and lower-tail CVaR, plus mean-quantile self-distillation.
init_recovers: Standard QR-DQN at gate g=0 and consistency_coef=0.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to QR-DQN, the next-state action used to form Bellman targets blends expectation and lower-tail CVaR with weight g(t) driven by an EMA of recent TD errors (cautious early, greedy once stable), and adds a 0.15·SmoothL1 self-distillation between current mean Q and target-mean — neither QR-DQN, C51, nor Double DQN tempers risk by TD uncertainty.
